visual.general_description: Four-panel CT figure (A to D) of the chest with colored arrows: a volume-rendered frontal view and axial, coronal and sagittal lung-window slices.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Three-dimensional volume-rendered CT view of both lungs in a frontal orientation, shown in pale blue-gray tones against a black background, with a dark area below the lungs. Four magenta arrows point at the outer lung margins, two on each side of the image. Four red arrows point at the lower portion of the lung field, two in the middle and two near the bottom. The letter A is printed at the lower left. No right or left side markers, scale or other text are printed. Panel B: Axial CT slice through the lower chest in lung window with the heart and spine visible. Both lungs show a web-like pattern of thickened lines with rounded dark spaces. One green arrow points to the anterior chest region at the upper right of the image, and blue arrows point to the thickened web-like areas in both lungs. The letter B is printed at the lower left. No right or left side markers or other text are printed. Panel C: Coronal CT slice of the chest in lung window showing both lungs, the trachea and the heart and great vessels in the midline. A yellow arrow points to the upper part of the lung at the right of the image, two orange arrows point toward the central lung regions from either side, and a row of red arrows runs along the outer lower margin of the lung at the right of the image where a dark crescent is visible. The letter C is printed at the lower left. No right or left side markers or other text are printed. Panel D: Sagittal CT slice of one hemithorax in lung window showing the lung with web-like thickened lines, the heart at the lower part of the image and the chest wall along the left edge. Three red arrows on the left of the image point toward a dark gas-filled space along the lower anterior chest wall. The letter D is printed at the lower left. No side markers or other text are printed.
